paragraphs: Ekimetrics is a leader in Marketing Effectiveness, Data Science and AI‑powered solutions. In London you will work as a Junior Consultant, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness, applying econometrics and AI to business problems. The London office engages across four business offerings: MMM (mixed market modelling), customer analytics, data science transformations and AI4 sustainability. You will work on Marketing Mix Modelling and Customer Analytics projects end‑to‑end, from gathering and analysing data to building statistical machine‑learning models and delivering presentations for clients across retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance and many other industries. global team

I have built predictive models using scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras, and I have deployed them with FastAPI inside Docker containers. In another project I created metadata pipelines that brought together fourteen source datasets, enabling feature engineering for model development. Both tasks required me to design end‑to‑end modelling workflows that meet the econometrics and advanced analytics expectations of the role, demonstrating my capability to deliver high‑quality modelling solutions for Marketing Effectiveness challenges. All code was written in python, ensuring reproducibility and clear documentation. The pipelines were version‑controlled and integrated into continuous integration pipelines for reliable execution.

I have communicated technical solutions to stakeholders using an agentic approach, combining Python and PostgreSQL to build transparent data pipelines that stakeholders could query directly, with continuous integration ensuring reliable delivery. I also implemented SSL encryption and AWS Cognito authentication for a FinTech application, and I explained the security architecture clearly to non‑technical clients. These experiences show my ability to convey analytical insights and technical details effectively, meeting the communication standards required for this consultancy role. I regularly produced written reports and delivered oral briefings, adapting the level of detail to the audience’s expertise. consistently.
